sources.observed: The ASCII string reference documents caret encoding of control characters and caret-space for a literal caret. The 3DSOLID/SURFACE tables describe modeler group 1 as proprietary data and group 3 as additional/continuation text lines, capped at 255 characters per line.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Normative DXF text-string and entity-carrier references; they do not define libdxfrw's in-memory raw SAT contract, prove every payload semantic, or establish B-rep validity/native acceptance.

sources.observed: DRW_ModelerGeometry::parseCode manually decodes caret-space in each group-1/3 value. writeDxfSatTextPayloadChunks uses writeDxfSatTextValue when chunk metadata exists, but with an empty map falls back to writeDxfTextChunks and raw writeString. The raw path does not escape the caret; therefore a synthesized payload containing caret-space is written in a spelling the parser decodes to a caret, losing the following space. DRW_Surface instead retains/writes raw carrier bytes and does not use the modeler parser's caret decoder.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Source-confirmed mismatch by direction/call-path inspection; no executable reproduction or peer/native acceptance was run in this pass.

finding.title: Synthesized/no-chunk SAT caret escape symmetry
finding.statement: The modeler group-1/3 parser always interprets caret-space as a literal caret. The explicit-chunk writer escapes literal carets before chunking, but the accepted empty-chunk fallback writes raw SAT bytes. A synthesized payload containing caret-space therefore loses its space on readback.
implementationPlan: Extend runModelerDxfWriterMatrix with generated AC1018/AC1024 ASCII/Binary public writer/import controls for an empty chunk map containing literal caret-space, with exact payload, source-immutability, following-record and EOF assertions.

Route the empty-map path through one SAT-specific bounded escape/chunk policy; preflight the complete value before record publication and keep caret pairs indivisible across the 255-character boundary.
Re-export/re-import once and compare ordered group-1/3 tags plus exact payload bytes; retain existing explicit-chunk and qualified AC1015 SAT-v1 controls.
Add an ASCII/Binary SURFACE raw-carrier negative control so this targeted fix cannot apply the semantic-string codec to raw surface bytes.

Build the touched target and run build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --modeler-dxf-matrix directly, plus scoped git diff --check. Run the broader owning CTest at its existing cadence; add no CTest registration. Use lc3_compat_check only for public API/layout edits.
